dryRun.description: Prints each change and makes none, as NX_DRY_RUN=true does

nxReleaseVersionData.description: Versions nx release set in this run, a project it left unversioned is skipped

registry.description: Registry nx release publish passes as --registry, in the form the tool names one

publish.description: The tool's publish argument list, followed by each file the target's dependency targets declare as outputs

title: Publish
description: Publishes the files a project's packaging targets wrote through its tool's own publish command, skipping a project nx release left unversioned; runs through nx release publish
